desc: The TP9 SF Elite, besides its comfortable carry attribute such as: size, trigger reach, and comfortability, was designed with shooters with small hands in mind or desiring a better trigger reach. Scott Warren designed a standard fiber optic forward sight post and blackened rear sight post, enabling shooters to transition from target to target in the fastest way possible while allowing for a simple sight picture. Just like all the TP series pistols, it comes with: A carrying case that contains a holster, a bigger backstrap, and a speed loader, as well as 2 Mec-Gar branded magazines as standard accessories. Coming in at an unloaded weight of 28.22 oz and an OAL of 7.28 inches, makes the TP9 SF Elite a joy to shoot and an extremely reliable package, that is easy to handle.
